concept: - MONDO:0001403 | labium majus cancer | syn: cancer of labium majora; labium majora cancer; malignant labia majora neoplasm; malignant labia majora tumor | ancestors: vulva cancer, skin cancer, female reproductive organ cancer, vulvar neoplasm | def: A malignant neoplasm involving the labium majora.

- MONDO:0006585 | neurodermatitis | syn: lichen simplex Chronicus | ancestors: dermatitis, skin disorder, inflammatory disease, integumentary system disorder | def: Skin findings arising from repeated rubbing, picking or scratching of a real or imagined irritation of the skin.
